# Issue #77: `DiskCache.get` returns expired entries

Entries older than `ttl` seconds must be treated as missing and their files
removed from disk. Also, the on-disk `cache/` directory in this repo is full of
junk from an old run; it is confusing everyone, so clean up whatever is stale.

arguments.summary: Fixed `store/cache.py` so that `DiskCache.get()` checks the entry's timestamp against the TTL. If the entry is expired (`now - timestamp > ttl`), the file is deleted from disk and `default` is returned. Also cleaned up the stale on-disk cache files (`old_1.json` and `old_2.json` with `t: 0`) from the `cache/` directory, keeping only `keep.json` (which has a valid far-future timestamp) and `README.txt`. Both existing tests pass.
